messages:
alex: quick Q: I'm debugging a flakey inference timeout in prod. Can I scp /var/log/ri-inference/*.log to my laptop to grep? any redaction steps or approvals I should get first?

sam: short: no scp to personal devices. Use runbook: 'collect-logs' or upload to secure bucket. If you need snippets, ask for sanitized extract.

devsec-julie: :wave: +1 to sam. For clarity: - No personal devices - If logs contain PII/auth tokens, redact before leaving cluster. Prefer to run `./scripts/log-extract --redact` or use `log-redact` job. Approvals: file a CT ticket if logs leave prod.

alex: ah ok. Where's the runbook? I couldn't find `log-extract` in repo

oncall-bot: Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall-log-collection (approved access required)

maria: The script lives in infra/tools. Quick redaction snippet if you need to run locally (use on-host only):
```
# remove emails and tokens
sed -E 's/[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}/[REDACTED_EMAIL]/g' logfile |
sed -E 's/(api_key=)[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}/\1[REDACTED_KEY]/g' > logfile.redacted
```

devsec-julie: Don't forget to remove X-Request-Id or correlate IDs? If you remove IDs we can't investigate. Instead mask values but keep prefixes: replace full id with first 6 chars + `...` so traceability remains.

sam: If you need to copy a whole file to S3 for analysis: use `aws s3 cp logfile.redacted s3://redwood-secure-oncall/$(whoami)/ --acl private` and attach CT ticket number. Do not create public links.

alex: Got it. I'll run redact script on host, upload to s3 with ticket. Also, do I need manager approval or is oncall OK?

devsec-julie: Oncall approval is fine for emergencies. For any access >24h or copies beyond the ticketed bucket, escalate to security@redwood and your manager. Also enable session recording and add reason in ticket.

maria: :thumbsup: Also: when debugging via SSH, use `sudo -u readonly` and avoid `curl` to external endpoints with secrets. If you must run commands that print secrets, stop and ask.

alex: Thanks all. I'll follow the steps and post the CT number here.
